# ARIS mode for DeepSeek Harness 0.2
English | 中文
> A fork of the upstream `dsh-aris` branch for DeepSeek Harness (dsh) 0.2.x. The full ARIS project —
every workflow, the docs, and the other host adaptations — lives on upstream `main`. Design and rat
ionale: `dsh/SPEC.md`.
ARIS runs as its own **agent preset**. Pick **ARIS** in the preset picker next to Standard and PTC,
and that session gets all 84 ARIS skills plus an independent reviewer. Other presets, and your defau
lt model, are untouched.
The reviewer runs **inside dsh** as a subagent, on the providers your profile already has (anthropic
, openai-codex, providerproxy, deepseek-official, any custom route). It is always from a **different
model family** than the session's model — a Claude session is reviewed by GPT, a GPT session by Cla
ude. If no such route is available the review fails with `REVIEW_UNAVAILABLE`; it never falls back t
o self-review. No Codex CLI, Python bridge, or extra login is needed.
The skills are unmodified upstream `main` (`26b95cf`, 2026-10-07). They keep calling `mcp__codex__co
dex` / `mcp__codex__codex-reply`; this package serves those tool names from dsh.
## Install
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Restart dsh (`dsh web`, or your service) — plugin code loads at startup. Then open a new session, ch
oose **ARIS** in the preset picker before the first message, and type `/` to see the ARIS skills.
`dsh plugin` shells out to **pnpm**, which dsh does not bundle.
Check the layer applied:

## How the reviewer works
| Skill call | What runs |
| `mcp__codex__codex {prompt, model, config.model_reasoning_effort, sandbox, cwd}` | Picks a reviewe

r route, starts a dsh child session on it, returns its answer. |
| `mcp__codex__codex-reply {threadI
d, prompt}` | Same route/effort/sandbox; the child sees every earlier round of the thread. |
Route selection:
1. The executor is the calling session's live model; its family comes from the model id (so one gate

way serving both Claude and GPT is handled).
2. The configured reviewer routes are the only reviewer
models. A skill's pinned `model` (most pin `gpt-6-astra`) only moves a route serving that exact mod

el to the front.
3. The first route of a different family that resolves wins. Defaults, in order: `o
penai-codex/gpt-6.1-sol`, `providerproxy/gpt-6.1-sol`, `anthropic/claude-opus-5-5`, `providerproxy/c
laude-opus-5-5`, `deepseek-official/deepseek-v4-pro`. So GPT reviews run on GPT-6.1 Sol, not Astra.
4. Effort never drops below the requested tier: `ultra` → `max` then `xhigh`; `xhigh` → `xhigh` then
rt never drops below the requested tier: `ultra` → `max` then `xhigh`; `xhigh` → `xhigh` then `max`.
Every result starts with one line the skills record into `REVIEW_STATE.json`:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
The reviewer gets `read`, `read_image`, `glob`, `grep`, `web_search`, `web_fetch` and `skill`; `sand
box: workspace-write` adds `bash`/`write`/`edit`. It cannot delegate or call the reviewer tools. Thr
eads persist in `$DSH_HOME/aris/reviewer-threads/` and survive restarts.
Override the routes (and `timeoutMs`, default 20 minutes) on the host row in your profile patch. dsh
patches cannot address rows nested inside a preset, so the knobs live on `aris-host`:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
## Optional rows (disabled)
| Row | Enable when |
| `aris-scope-limits` | You want the reviewer's scope limits applied to the executor too (costs toke

ns every request). |
| `aris-grok` | The `grok` CLI is installed: adds `grok` / `grok-reply` consult

ation tools (upstream #454). |
| `aris-antigravity` | The `agy` CLI is installed: adds `antigravity`
/ `antigravity-reply`. |
These consultation bridges are not reviewer routes and never satisfy an acceptance gate.
## The ARIS tab
Sessions get a read-only **ARIS** tab beside Chat and Trajectory. It reads `review-stage/REVIEW_STAT
E.json` from the session's workspace and shows who reviewed the latest round and whether the familie
s differ. It never writes, advances a round, or turns a score into a completion decision.
## Tests
[代码示例省略，未执行]
`preset-drift.test.mjs` compares the preset's copied Standard rows against the installed dsh; run it
after every dsh upgrade.
## Known limits
- **Tracks one dsh line.** Verified on dsh `0.2.1-alpha.2`. Presets were redesigned in 2026-09; re-r

un the tests on every upgrade.
- **Web only.** dsh presets are a Web-surface concept; the headless a

nd TUI profiles do not show ARIS mode.
- **No per-preset model.** ARIS mode uses the session's model

; dsh 0.2.1 has no preset-level default.
- **Replay cost.** Each reply round resends the thread's ea

rlier rounds to a fresh reviewer child.
- **Do not also install the upstream Codex MCP server** in t
his preset: it registers the same tool names.
